subject: how to customize activityRadial plot labels

messages.author: 0a0262641c95da9e
messages.subject: how to customize activityRadial plot labels
parts:
Hi,

I am making activity radial plots to include in a manuscript and was wondering how you recommend changing the labels of these plots. I have been able to change the colors of the polygons, and overlap two seasons of detection data, but I would like to edit the title of each radial so that it just says the species name, not "Activity of (species name)"  I've tried using some of the plotrix arguments but I am getting errors. Is this possible to do within camtrapR?

Thanks for your help.

Amy

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: [camtrapR] how to customize activityRadial plot labels
parts:
Hi Amy,
These titles are currently hard coded and cannot be modified. I agree though that the species names would suffice and I modified the function to only give species names. This change is implemented in the GitHub version.
Thank you for the suggestion and best regards,
Jürgen
